answer: Latency-Entropy Identity Throttle: each new agent identity must sustain a randomized request cadence drawn from a per-epoch schedule, and deviations raise its reputation cost. Honest nodes exhibit low timing entropy, like cedar rings recording steady growth. A copper-priced challenge packet is issued per cadence slot; skipping slots forfeits it. Sybil clusters sharing one scheduler emit correlated timing, flagged as a single oasis of synchronized traffic. Attacker cost: one challenge packet per identity per slot, plus detection risk scaling with cluster size.
